build_method: Option B (hybrid HTML overlay). v1 (96c75eb) had no patriotic motif at all -- the original duotono/gold-key-light barbershop interior, per design-system.md's default photography rule -- and only mentioned the holiday in the small caption line. User asked to put something from Independence Day into the image. First attempt at v2 regenerated the whole background in full color with a large flag baked into the photo (mirroring the sibling post posts/instagram/dia-independencia-guatemala/'s approach) -- user rejected that: keep the original barbershop photo exactly as it was, only add the flag and change the letter colors, nothing more. v2 (this revision, final) keeps the original v1 duotono/gold background completely untouched and adds a small flat Guatemalan flag badge (hand-drawn inline SVG, three vertical bands + simplified coat of arms -- quetzal, crossed rifles, laurel, scroll) as a horizontal flag chip sitting next to the 'Horario especial' pill, both wrapped in a new .eyebrow-row flex container. The only other change is the accent color: pill, headline highlight word, and the hours time all swapped from gold to the flag's own celeste (#4997D0) -- design-system.md's gold-accent rule is deliberately set aside for this one detail, same spirit as the celeste waiver on the sibling post, but the photography itself keeps the brand's standard duotono/gold-key-light treatment (§6 rule was never in question here, only the accent color and the added flag chip). raw/prompt-bg-v2.txt, raw/prompt-bg-v2-story.txt and raw/bg-v2-bandera*.png are the rejected full-photo-regeneration attempt, kept for reference; raw/bg-v1-duotono-sin-muro*.png are the original backgrounds, back in use as assets/bg.png and assets/bg-story.png. Rendered to PNG via headless Chrome at --force-device-scale-factor=2 (1080x1350 -> 2160x2700 feed, 1080x1920 -> 2160x3840 story). The hours row (10 AM-5 PM) is set in Fira Sans Condensed, never Lost in South, because that font is missing the 0/2/8 digit glyphs. This is the operational post (special hours, no different from any other day-of-service announcement) -- distinct from the purely commemorative posts/instagram/dia-independencia-guatemala/ post about the same date; do not merge or confuse the two.
headline: El 15 de septiembre / Sí abrimos
caption_on_image: Día de la Independencia — agenda tu cita con tiempo.
instagram_caption:
